facts.text: The user is planning a two-week holiday to Tanzania.
The user is traveling with a young couple.
The user wants a detailed 2-week day-to-day agenda for the trip.
The user wants the itinerary to include cocktails, clubbing, museums, good food, music, and possibly ocean-related activities.
The user does not want climbing mountains, nature, or hiking included in the itinerary.
The user wants the itinerary to take weather forecasts, price, Google reviews, time of day, and proximity into account.
The user asked to include addresses and the distance/time needed to move between places on the agenda.
The user said the holiday is two weeks long.
The user said the assistant only gave two days.

events.text: User requested a detailed 2-week day-to-day agenda for a Tanzania trip starting tomorrow morning
User asked to include addresses and distance/time between itinerary stops
User corrected that the holiday is two weeks long and noted only two days were provided
